newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Palestinian leader expected to visit Russia.
newsitem.headline: Palestinian leader expected to visit Russia.

text.p: Palestinian leader Yassar Arafat is likely to visit Moscow next week and a Palestinian official said on Monday that Arafat would hold talks with Russian President Boris Yeltsin.
"There is of course a meeting with the president," the official from the Palestinian representation in Moscow said. "They will discuss mutual relations and the peace process in the Middle East."

The Kremlin could not comment on the visit, but a Russian Foreign Ministry spokesman said the visit, planned for February 18 and 19, was on the agenda. Preparatory work, however, had not yet started, he added.

Russia has been a joint-sponsor, with the United States, of the Middle East peace process. Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu is expected in Moscow in March, but a date has not yet been set for the visit. Netanyahu is due in Washington later this week for talks with U.S. President Bill Clinton.
